id: title:adboio:let users dismiss files uploaded by a run

review.posthog_relevance: Adds transactional safety and a dismissal restoration path to the artifact manifest update and the dismissal API, potentially preventing lost updates and allowing restoration of dismissed artifacts without permanent deletion.
review.reason: Adds a transaction and row lock to the artifact manifest update, and a dismissal restoration path. Adds a new tool configuration and corresponding request/response schema for dismissing task run artifacts. Adds a field to the artifact response schema to record when an artifact was dismissed. Adds request and response interfaces for the dismiss operation.

observations.behavior: Adds a transaction and row lock to the artifact manifest update, and a dismissal restoration path.
